# Senior Software Engineer Resume

## About this template

I am a Senior Software Engineer with over 8 years of experience architecting scalable web applications and leading high-performance engineering teams. Specialized in full-stack development, cloud infrastructure, microservices architecture, and DevOps automation. I have successfully designed and delivered mission-critical systems serving 10M+ users, achieving significant cost reductions and reliability improvements. Passionate about clean code, system design, and engineering excellence, I am committed to driving team growth and technical innovation.
